caption: Tokyo eats you CAN'T miss 🍜 1. Ichiran Shibuya - open 24h, solo booths 2. Tsujihan Nihonbashi kaisendon, queue 30 min 3. Shibuya Sky at sunset (book 2 weeks ahead!) #tokyo #japantravel #fyp
48h in Seoul 🇰🇷 started at Gwangjang Market for bindaetteok, then hiked up to N Seoul Tower for the view. Night: Ikseon-dong alleys for cafes ☕️ #seoul #koreatravel
POV: you finally tried Jay Fai's crab omelette ⭐️ worth the 3 hour wait?? then rooftop drinks at Sky Bar Lebua 🍸 #bangkok #streetfood
Taipei night market crawl: Raohe Street Night Market for pepper buns (Fuzhou Shizu Pepper Bun at the entrance!!) and Shilin for the giant fried chicken. Also Din Tai Fung Xinyi is a must 🥟
